def export_rsa_private_key(private_key, desired_format='openssh', password=None):
    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
    fmt = _normalize_format(desired_format)
    password_bytes = None if password is None else password.encode() if isinstance(password, str) else password
    encryption = serialization.NoEncryption() if password_bytes is None else serialization.BestAvailableEncryption(password_bytes)
    if fmt == 'openssh':
       return private_key.private_bytes(encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM, format=serialization.PrivateFormat.OpenSSH, encryption_algorithm=encryption)
    elif fmt == 'pem':
       return private_key.private_bytes(encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM, format=serialization.PrivateFormat.TraditionalOpenSSL, encryption_algorithm=encryption)
    elif fmt == 'pkcs8':
       return private_key.private_bytes(encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM, format=serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8, encryption_algorithm=encryption)
    elif fmt == 'der':
       return private_key.private_bytes(encoding=serialization.Encoding.DER, format=serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8, encryption_algorithm=encryption)
